environment: Actual Godot 4.6.1 / Jolt. Fixture positions and authentic target rays, action validation, meshes, physics and save/restore. Not human gameplay.

results.name: Host ray reaches the physical storage chest
Held book becomes a unique persisted container reference
Open chest shows its stored original book model
Closing lid hides contents and retains them
Full chest cannot be moved or removed
Whole world restore retains the open chest and physical contents
Two contenders cannot extract the same stored object twice
Extracted item regains collision and is held with bounded physics
Drawer slides along its model anchor
Lamp interaction changes shared persisted power state
Powered-off lamp emits no local light
